mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS "id", p.schedule_date AS "scheduleDate", COALESCE((SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = p.client_code LIMIT 1), '') AS "clientName", COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN pdn.spec IS NOT NULL AND pdn.spec != '' THEN pdn.name || '(' || pdn.spec || ')' ELSE pdn.name END FROM products pdn WHERE pdn.code = p.product_code), '') AS "productName", COALESCE(p.order_qty, '') AS "orderQty", COALESCE(p.lot_no, '') AS "lotNo", COALESCE(p.product_code, '') AS "productCode", COALESCE(p.note, '') AS "note", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM production_material_substitution s WHERE s.schedule_id = p.id) AS "substitutionCount" FROM production_schedule p WHERE p.schedule_date = #{date} ORDER BY p.sort_order, p.id

SELECT id AS "id", schedule_date AS "scheduleDate", (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = production_schedule.client_code LIMIT 1) AS "clientName", (SELECT CASE WHEN pdn.spec IS NOT NULL AND pdn.spec != '' THEN pdn.name || '(' || pdn.spec || ')' ELSE pdn.name END FROM products pdn WHERE pdn.code = production_schedule.product_code) AS "productName", order_qty AS "orderQty", lot_no AS "lotNo", product_code AS "productCode", note AS "note" FROM production_schedule WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT code FROM products WHERE name = #{displayName} OR (spec IS NOT NULL AND spec != '' AND (name || '(' || spec || ')' = #{displayName} OR name || ' (' || spec || ')' = #{displayName})) ORDER BY code LIMIT 1

SELECT id AS "id", schedule_id AS "scheduleId", from_material_code AS "fromMaterialCode", from_material_name AS "fromMaterialName", to_material_code AS "toMaterialCode", to_material_name AS "toMaterialName", reason AS "reason", created_at AS "createdAt", COALESCE((SELECT emp.name FROM employees emp WHERE emp.id = created_by LIMIT 1), created_by) AS "createdBy" FROM production_material_substitution WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} ORDER BY id

SELECT b.material_code AS "materialCode", COALESCE(m.name, b.material_name) AS "materialName", b.ratio_percent AS "ratio" FROM bom b LEFT JOIN materials m ON m.code = b.material_code WHERE b.product_code = #{productCode} AND b.material_code IS NOT NULL AND b.material_code != '' AND b.ratio_percent IS NOT NULL ORDER BY b.ratio_percent DESC
SELECT name FROM materials WHERE code = #{code} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bom WHERE product_code = #{productCode} AND material_code = #{materialCode}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM production_material_substitution WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND from_material_code = #{materialCode}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM production_material_substitution WHERE id = #{id} AND schedule_id = #{scheduleId}
mapper.select: SELECT code AS "code", name AS "name", stock_qty AS "stockQty" FROM materials WHERE name IS NOT NULL AND use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY name
